quotes.author: Clinton Brown
quotes.text: This was as simple as it gets. The reservation, fast and easy. The directions fast and easy. And most of all, getting the machines, the low down on operations clear and perfectly done. The hour went by to fast but was SO enjoyable. Thank you for starting our day so enjoyable Thanks

quotes.author: Ana Bananas
quotes.text: Chris and Malcom provided excellent service. They welcome us with enthusiasm, we drove 2hrs to them. We got there earlier of the time we agreed and they got us riding right away. Plus the free parking spot they provide was on point. We coming back for sure.

quotes.author: Clark Gimenez
quotes.text: Chris was awesome. Quickly gave us all (3) the instructions and the ins and outs of where to ride. The waverunners themselves were all practically brand new and rode extremely well. Highly recommend Chris and his waverunner experience. Great time.

quotes.author: Jonathan Smith
quotes.text: Anytime on a jetski on the water is a good time! Thank you Chris for being an awesome host and assisting with all our needs. 10/10 recommend to anyone looking for a good time on the water!

quotes.author: Wendy Dempsey
quotes.text: Great time jet skiing in the inter coastal. Very fun, safe and jet skis were in great condition. We were able to stay next to the dolphins while they played. So fun! Highly recommend!!

quotes.author: David Howell
quotes.text: Me and the kids had a blast. Jetski was really nice and clean. Guy was very nice and made sure we had all the proper instructions before going out.
